intro: Knapheide’s Drop Side Dump Truck Body is the premier light duty dump truck bodies for class three to five chassis. https://www.knapheide.com/enclosed-servi.title: Aluminum KUVcc Enclosed Service Body
intro: The Knapheide aluminum KUVcc enclosed service truck body boasts the same features as our standard aluminum service bodies with the added security and functionality of a covered roof. Available for both single and dual-rear-wheel chassis, with numerous lengths and roof heights, there’s an Aluminum KUVcc for your line of work or needs. Check out the many features and options and submit a quote request today so you can start building the ultimate truck body today. A versatile, lightweight, practical solution for a variety of vocations, Knapheide’s Aluminum KUVcc is an ideal choice for tradespeople everywhere.

features.heading: LED Tail Lights
features.body: These surface mounted rectangular tail lights feature bright LED illumination, stop/turn/backup signaling, and built-in reflectivity with an option available upon request for strobing functionality with 8 selectable pattern choices. Guards inside the rear compartments protect interior wiring and other related components. The tail light’s housing, orientation and placement on the body may vary.

features.heading: Automotive Latches
features.body: Our 6-year warranty backed automotive quality, paddle activated rotary latches make opening and closing compartment doors easy. Interior latching mechanisms include covers to prevent potential damage caused by shifting cargo inside the compartments. Locking can be facilitated via the included key entry feature and/or a power lock option available upon request.

features.heading: Door Design
features.body: All compartment doors utilize pry-proof continuous hinges, weather protecting neoprene door seals, adjustable security ring striker for tighter closing, and spring or strut retainers to prevent involuntary door swing. Steel models are constructed of double-shell 20-guage, two-sided A-40 galvanneal steel while aluminum models are made from 6061 T6 and 5052 military grade aluminum.

features.heading: External Compartments
features.body: The size of compartments is influenced by the cab-to-axle length of the vehicle chassis or cutaway and the body height you plan to choose. Consult our specifications table for further guidance. Front vertical compartments have two shelves while full height rear vertical and curb side horizontal compartments have one shelf. Each adjustable shelf is rated to hold 250-lbs. with removable dividers every 4-inches.

features.heading: Fender Skirts
features.body: Fender skirts are made from TPO or thermoplastic olefin, a common material in automotive bodies praised for its lightweight nature, impact resistance, and durability when exposed to weather or harsh substances.

features.heading: Master Locking System
features.body: Master Locking System locks down all of the side compartments on one side by utilizing a padlock, provides an additional layer of security.

https://www.knapheide.com/saw-trucks/.title: Saw Truck
intro: The primary purpose of Knapheide’s saw truck body is to offer an optimal transportation solution for concrete contractors that allows simple and safe loading and unloading of heavy concrete saws and equipment essential in slab and flat cutting. In addition, the uniquely specialized unit is engineered for efficient storage and organization of blades, hoses, cords, tools and supplies. Remarkably, this dedicated design often eliminates the need for ancillary trailers or other support vehicles.

features.heading: Body Shell
features.body: Rugged 14-gauge, two-sided A-40 galvanneal steel body shell with a six year warranty. Complete undercoating provides an additional layer of corrosion protection.

features.heading: Street Side Compartments
features.body: The front 60-inch tall vertical compartment has overlapping doors, one fixed shelf and saw blade holders. On 14 and 16-foot models, a second 60-inch tall vertical compartment with three adjustable shelves is included. Above the rear wheels sits a 36-inch tall compartment with overlapping doors and two adjustable shelves. A fixed, double wall panel then extends from this compartment to the rear of the platform.

features.heading: Curb Side Compartments
features.body: The front 60-inch tall vertical compartment has overlapping doors, three adjustable shelves, and two hose/cord square tube holders. On 14 and 16-foot models, a second 60-inch tall vertical compartment with three adjustable shelves is included. Above the rear wheels sits a 36-inch tall compartment with overlapping doors and two adjustable shelves. A fixed, double wall panel then extends from this compartment to the rear of the platform.

features.heading: Liftgate
features.body: The Dhollandia cantilever liftgate allows for safe and easy ground-t0-bed loading of heavy concrete saws and other cargo weighing up to 3,300 lbs. It stows vertically against the rear of the bed as a tailgate when not in use. Optional pendant control is available upon request.

features.heading: Receiver Hitch
features.body: Bed includes 18,000 lb. rated receiver hitch with 7-way flat trailer plug.

features.heading: LED Tail Lights
features.body: These surface mounted rectangular tail lights feature bright LED illumination, stop/turn/backup signaling, and built-in reflectivity with an option available upon request for strobing functionality with 8 selectable pattern choices. Guards inside the rear compartments protect interior wiring and other related components. The tail light’s housing, orientation and placement on the body may vary.

features.heading: T-Handles
features.body: 3 point T-Handles ensure your compartment doors stay closed and are individually lockable. Interior latching mechanisms include covers to prevent potential damage caused by shifting cargo inside. Locking can be facilitated via the included key entry feature and/or a power lock option available upon request.

features.heading: Door Design
features.body: All compartment doors utilize pry-proof continuous hinges, weather protecting neoprene door seals, adjustable security ring striker for tighter closing, and spring or strut retainers to prevent involuntary door swing. Steel models are constructed of double-shell 20-guage, two-sided A-40 galvanneal steel while aluminum models are made from 6061 T6 and 5052 military grade aluminum.
